defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively before a known burst of damage or a tankbuster cleave to reduce all damage taken by 40% for 8 seconds.

defensives.name: Stone Bulwark Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Drop ahead of incoming damage to absorb a large initial hit plus periodic shields; talent_gated since not every build takes it.

defensives.name: Ancestral Guidance
defensives.usage_rule: Activate during a high-output window to convert a portion of your damage into raid healing; talent_gated and best used when you are already bursting.

defensives.name: Earth Elemental
defensives.usage_rule: Summon to soak a hit or pull threat off the group as an emergency tank-swap or damage-soak tool when no offensive use is needed.
